incident-bot: eval-gate ALERT triggered: safety_regression_detector • model=redwood-open-3b-quant • metric=toxicity_delta • threshold=0.12 • PagerDuty page fired PD-4821 • severity=P1
Alex K: ack — i'll take it. moving to phone for PD ack.
PagerDuty: Incident PD-4821 acknowledged by Alex K
Maya S: @Alex K oncall — console graph shows safety rejects jumping from ~0.3% to ~6.8% starting ~22:33 UTC. can you confirm customer impact?
Alex K: quick scan — hits are structured safety rejects (403-like) on /generate for some EU customers. looks like ~2 enterprise orgs seeing user-facing rejects. collecting exact org ids.
Sam R: FYI we rolled a model variant into routing at 22:15 UTC (redwood-open-3b-quant v2026-03-14). eval gate should have flagged this but threshold tripped late.
Jules: pulling eval logs — looks like classifier input distribution shifted. will attach failing samples in a sec.
Priya: runbook step 2 for P1 quality: enable fallback to previous stable model. can we toggle routing back to v2026-02-28 for the affected route?
Alex K: doing the route toggle now. executing runbook command.
Alex K: /runbook toggle-route --route=/api/v1/generate --from=redwood-open-3b-quant@v2026-03-14 --to=redwood-open-3b-quant@v2026-02-28
eng-runtime-bot: route toggle accepted. change_id=chg-8712. propagation expected ~30s.
Alex K: routing change applied — metrics show ~98% traffic on v2026-02-28 after ~42s.
Maya S: monitoring — safety reject rate falling back to baseline.
Maya S: timeline so far:
- 22:33 UTC: eval-gate triggered PD-4821
- 22:34 UTC: oncall ack (Alex K)
- 22:36 UTC: routing fallback applied
Sam R: suggested temporary mitigation: bump canary eval-gate threshold to 0.18 for 5% canary traffic to get more telemetry while preventing widespread looseness.
Jules: caution — raising threshold globally could hide true violations. prefer canary-only threshold change.
Alex K: agreed. applying canary config.
Alex K: /config set eval_gate.safety_regression_detector.canary_threshold=0.18 --canary=5%
config-bot: config updated. canary=5% of traffic uses threshold 0.18
Priya: @Sam @Jules please run expedited eval of v2026-03-14 vs extended safety corpus + customer prompts (include emoji & punctuation edge cases). need root cause: tokenization vs model change.
Sam R: starting eval job eval-9824 now. will post artifacts in ~15m.
Customer Success Bot: Notifying potentially affected customers (cust-acme, cust-orion): we applied a routing fallback and are investigating an automated quality regression. no action required on your side. cs-message-id=cs-441
Alex K: impact snapshot: ~11k requests hit safety reject window between 22:15–22:36 UTC; ~6k were user-facing structured rejects. refining counts + list of affected orgs.
Maya S: opening incident bridge: zoom.com/bridge/incident-PD4821 — joining now.
Alex K: on bridge.
Jules: preliminary eval summary: classifier score shift aligns with tokenizer normalization change in runtime used during quantization. emoji and extended-punct split patterns changed, shifting classifier inputs.
Priya: if tokenizer drift is implicated, audit embedding service rollout earlier today and any tokenizer flags. eng-infra tagging.
eng-infra-bot: acknowledged. rolling back tokenizer normalization flag on canary infra. change_id=cfg-559
Sam R: mitigation plan:
1) revert tokenizer normalization in runtime (in progress)
2) retrain/finetune safety classifier with new tokenization (est 48–72h)
3) expand pre-deploy eval to include emoji/extended punctuation sets and customer prompt corpus
Alex K: incident action items (for incident doc):
- ML + infra confirm root cause and artifactize failing samples
- forensic eval (Sam/Jules) and job outputs attached to incident
- postmortem + RCA + customer notification (Maya/CS)
- product/runtime: tighten pre-deploy eval for tokenization-sensitive changes
Sam R: eval-9824 results (prelim): higher false-positive rate for prompts with non-ascii punctuation and certain emoji sequences. toxicity_delta=0.145 (above gate threshold).
Jules: confirmed tokenizer normalization altered emoji->subtoken mapping; classifier training data not representative of new mapping.
Maya S: status update: routing fallback stable, safety rejects back to baseline. PD-4821 remains acknowledged until postmortem published.
Alex K: notifying legal/security for exposure assessment.
Legal Bot: legal@redwood: please provide incident summary and affected org list when available. will triage for PII/regulatory exposure.
Alex K: estimates: rollback + route toggle done; classifier retrain ~2–3 days. interim: keep canary at 5% with higher threshold for telemetry; no global threshold loosen.
Maya S: i'll update PD with notes and schedule an on-call handoff if needed. closing bridge in 5. incident doc URL: https://redwood.internal/incidents/PD-4821
Jules: uploading failing sample set and eval artifacts to incident doc.
Alex K: thanks everyone. will draft postmortem and share in #postmortems when RCA ready. :thumbsup:
